159: def _unquote_git(p: str) -> str:
160:     """Decode git's C-quoted path ("a\\tb" / octal UTF-8 escapes) to the
161:     real filename (dsh 2026-09-30 review; mainline merge 2026-10-15b)."""
162:     if len(p) < 2 or p[0] != '"' or p[-1] != '"':
163:         return p
164:     body = p[1:-1]
165:     simple = {"t": 9, "n": 10, "a": 7, "b": 8, "f": 12, "v": 11, "\\": 0x5C, '"': 0x22}
166:     out = bytearray()
167:     i, n = 0, len(body)
168:     while i < n:
169:         ch = body[i]
170:         if ch == "\\" and i + 1 < n:
171:             nxt = body[i + 1]
172:             if nxt in simple:
173:                 out.append(simple[nxt])
174:                 i += 2
175:                 continue
176:             if nxt in "01234567" and i + 3 < n and all(c in "01234567" for c in body[i + 2:i + 4]):
177:                 out.append(int(body[i + 1:i + 4], 8))
178:                 i += 4
179:                 continue
180:             out.append(ord(nxt))
181:             i += 2
182:             continue
183:         out.extend(ch.encode("utf-8"))
184:         i += 1
185:     return out.decode("utf-8", "replace")

188: def _wave_paths(root, base):
189:     """(paths, deleted) for the change wave — cheap preflight before
190:     `git log -p`. `deleted` = D-status paths (R3: deletion-only paths are
191:     shrink and never count against the wave-size ceiling)."""
192:     paths = set()
193:     deleted = set()
194:     def _absorb(status_out, net_only=False):
195:         # net_only=True feeds the NET diff (R3): a path is deletion-only iff
196:         # its FINAL state is D — "ever deleted" laundered re-added live paths
197:         # past the ceiling (review A PoC E1/E2).
198:         for l in status_out.splitlines():
199:             l = l.strip()
200:             if not l:
201:                 continue
202:             parts = l.split("\t")
203:             if len(parts) >= 2 and parts[0].startswith("D"):
204:                 deleted.add(parts[-1])
205:             elif net_only and len(parts) >= 2:
206:                 deleted.discard(parts[-1])
207:     if base:
208:         rc, out = _git(root, "log", "--name-only", "--format=", f"{base}..HEAD")
209:         rc_s, out_s = _git(root, "log", "--name-status", "--format=", f"{base}..HEAD")
210:     else:
211:         rc, out = _git(root, "show", "--name-only", "--format=", "HEAD")
212:         rc_s, out_s = _git(root, "show", "--name-status", "--format=", "HEAD")
213:     if rc == 0:
214:         paths.update(l for l in out.splitlines() if l.strip())
215:     if rc_s == 0:
216:         _absorb(out_s)
217:     for args in (["diff", "--name-only", "HEAD"],
218:                  ["diff", "--cached", "--name-only"]):
219:         rc, out = _git(root, *args)
220:         if rc == 0:
221:             paths.update(l for l in out.splitlines() if l.strip())
222:     for args in (["diff", "--name-status", "HEAD"],
223:                  ["diff", "--cached", "--name-status"]):
224:         rc, out = _git(root, *args)
225:         if rc == 0:
226:             _absorb(out, net_only=True)
227:     if base:
228:         rc, out = _git(root, "diff", "--name-status", base, "HEAD")
229:         if rc == 0:
230:             _absorb(out, net_only=True)

234: def wave_diff_text(root):
235:     """Change-wave diff: PER-COMMIT patches of newest `backup: before changes`
236:     commit..HEAD (a net range diff would hide intra-wave add-then-remove),
237:     else `git show HEAD`; plus uncommitted `git diff HEAD`. "" = no git repo.
238: 
239:     Bounded by PATH COUNT before materializing patches (2026-10-18 incident:
240:     45k pnpm paths / 1.3GB wave -> OOM). A too-large wave is a hard failure,
241:     not a silently empty diff."""
242:     global WAVE_TOO_LARGE
243:     key = str(root)
244:     if key in WAVE_CACHE:
245:         return WAVE_CACHE[key]
246:     rc, _ = _git(root, "rev-parse", "--git-dir")
247:     if rc != 0:
248:         WAVE_CACHE[key] = ""
249:         return ""
250:     base, base_kind = wave_base(root)
251:     if base_kind == "wave-base-invalid":
252:         global WAVE_TOO_LARGE
253:         WAVE_TOO_LARGE = f"- wave-base: {base} is not a resolvable ancestor commit of HEAD (fail-closed: an invalid anchor must never shrink the wave)"
254:         WAVE_CACHE[key] = ""
255:         return ""
256:     paths, deleted = _wave_paths(root, base)
257:     # R3 (W18): pure deletions are shrink, not growth — a hygiene wave that
258:     # only removes files never trips the wave-size ceiling (ratchet semantics:
259:     # shrinkage is always allowed); the guidance names the hygiene commit.
260:     live_paths = paths - deleted
261:     if len(live_paths) > UNTRACKED_LIMIT:
262:         WAVE_TOO_LARGE = f"{len(live_paths)} paths > {UNTRACKED_LIMIT} ({len(deleted)} deletion-only path(s) excluded)"
263:         WAVE_CACHE[key] = ""
264:         return ""
265:     parts = []
266:     if base:
267:         rc_p, d = _git(root, "log", "-p", "--format=", f"{base}..HEAD")
268:         if rc_p != 0:
269:             WAVE_TOO_LARGE = f"git log {base}..HEAD failed — cannot materialize the wave (fail-closed)"
270:             WAVE_CACHE[key] = ""
271:             return ""
272:         parts.append(d)
273:     else:
274:         rc_p, d = _git(root, "show", "--format=", "HEAD")
275:         if rc_p != 0:
276:             WAVE_TOO_LARGE = "git show HEAD failed — cannot materialize the wave (fail-closed)"
277:             WAVE_CACHE[key] = ""
278:             return ""
279:         parts.append(d)
280:     rc_d, d = _git(root, "diff", "HEAD")
281:     if rc_d != 0:
282:         WAVE_TOO_LARGE = "git diff HEAD failed — cannot materialize the uncommitted wave tail (fail-closed)"
283:         WAVE_CACHE[key] = ""
284:         return ""
285:     parts.append(d)
286:     text = "\n".join(parts)
287:     if len(text.encode("utf-8", "replace")) > 16 * 1024 * 1024:
288:         WAVE_TOO_LARGE = f"diff {len(text)} bytes > 16 MiB"
289:         text = ""
290:     WAVE_CACHE[key] = text
291:     return text

363: def parse_diff(text):
364:     """{path: [added, removed]} — added = [(new-file lineno, text)] via @@
365:     hunks; removed = [text]. Deleted files keep their `--- a/` path so
366:     removed lines and the path are retained (whole-file deletion must NOT
367:     fail-open the guards)."""
368:     files, cur, nline = {}, None, 0
369:     for line in text.splitlines():
370:         h = HUNK.match(line)
371:         if h:
372:             nline = int(h.group(1))
373:         elif line.startswith("--- a/"):
374:             # review R-I2: git C-quotes odd names ("tests/caf\303\251.py")
375:             # and pads space-names with a trailing tab — normalize both
376:             cur = _unquote_git(line[6:].rstrip("\t"))
377:             files.setdefault(cur, [[], []])
378:         elif line.startswith("+++ b/"):
379:             cur = _unquote_git(line[6:].rstrip("\t"))
380:             files.setdefault(cur, [[], []])
381:         elif line.startswith("--- /dev/null"):
382:             cur = None
383:         elif line.startswith("+++ /dev/null"):
384:             pass                                # deleted file: keep a/ path
385:         elif cur and line.startswith("+"):
386:             files[cur][0].append((nline, line[1:]))
387:             nline += 1
388:         elif cur and line.startswith("-"):
389:             files[cur][1].append(line[1:])
390:         elif line.startswith(" "):
391:             nline += 1
392:     return files

406: def secret_scan(root, vl=""):  # vl = CURRENT task block (approval scoping)
407:     """Group 14 — secret scan. Returns (fails, warns). Only ADDED diff lines
408:     and untracked files; placeholder-marked lines exempt; .md warn-only;
409:     any assert_artifacts.py never scanned. A `vw-approved` inline marker
410:     exempts a credential line ONLY when verification_log.md carries the
411:     path-scoped pairing `- secret-approved: <path> — <reason>` (marker count
412:     per path must be ≤ approvals for that path — same binding shape as group
413:     15's `- test-change: <path>`). A bare mention of the marker on a line
414:     that matches no credential pattern is a no-op (prose mentions never
415:     trip the gate). Pairing failures FAIL regardless of file type (the
416:     .md warn-only rule applies only to plain unmarked secrets)."""
417:     fails, warns, marker_paths = [], [], {}

419:     def hit(path, lineno, text):
420:         if "assert_artifacts.py" in path or PLACEHOLDER.search(text):
421:             return
422:         approval = bool(APPROVAL_METADATA.search(text))
423:         found = any(rx.search(text) for rx in SECRET_RES)
424:         if not found and not approval:
425:             m = GENERIC_KV.search(text)
426:             if m:
427:                 key = m.group("key") or ""
428:                 val = m.group("v") or ""
429:                 benign = False
430:                 benign_key = BENIGN_KEY.search(key)
431:                 if benign_key:
432:                     kind = benign_key.group("kind").lower()
433:                     benign = kind not in ("digits", "length", "len") or val.isdigit()
434:                 if not benign and PATH_KEY.search(key) and PATH_VALUE.match(val):
435:                     benign = True
436:                 if not m.group("q") and not benign:
437:                     tail = text[m.end():m.end() + 1]
438:                     benign = tail in ("(", "[") or bool(REFERENCE_VALUE.match(val))
439:                 found = not benign
440:         if not found:
441:             return
442:         if re.search(r"vw-approved", text, re.I):
443:             marker_paths[path] = marker_paths.get(path, 0) + 1
444:             return
445:         (warns if path.endswith(".md") else fails).append(
446:             f"secret scan: {path}:{lineno}: credential-looking string "
447:             # review A4/re-review R3: NEVER echo any matched content (this
448:             # detail is routed into gate block messages / session logs) —
449:             # cite shape only (length), zero secret material
450:             f"on an added line — {len(text.strip())} chars matched (redacted) (A4.4 content gate)")

452:     for path, (added, _r) in parse_diff(wave_diff_text(root)).items():
